summary: Backend-only regression test for bug fix on GET /api/organizations/me (load_dotenv moved to top of server.py so SUPABASE_URL is set before route modules import, plus organization_settings join fix). All 8 pytest cases PASS on the public URL. The previous DNS resolution error '[Errno -2] Name or service not known' is fully resolved. Login via Supabase returns a valid JWT; /api/organizations/me returns HTTP 200 with the expected payload for inbox@twofungis.ca: organization 'Two Fungis Finishing' (id a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002, role=owner, is_primary=true, subscription_tier=founding_lifetime), primary_organization_id set correctly, is_platform_admin=true, platform_role=platform_admin. Unauthorized and bad-token cases return the proper 401/422 codes rather than 500. /api/health and /api/organizations/health also return healthy, confirming Supabase env vars loaded correctly at startup.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: load_dotenv(override=False) is called before route imports which is correct. Good.
routes/organizations.py get_my_organizations(): the join `organizations(id,name,slug,subscription_tier)` returns the joined data correctly. No further changes needed.

routes/organizations.py verify_jwt_token(): uses jwt.decode(..., options={'verify_signature': False}) which does NOT validate the JWT signature. This is a security concern (any well-formed JWT with a `sub` claim passes). Consider validating against Supabase JWT secret. Not blocking for this bug fix but should be tracked.

Response includes internal fields like 'success' and 'count' that are undocumented in the Pydantic models (OrganizationSummary/OrganizationDetail) - the endpoint returns raw dicts, not typed models. Consider using response_model= for schema stability.

rca of the issue: Original bug: FastAPI route modules were imported at server.py load time, and each module read os.environ.get('SUPABASE_URL','') into a module-level constant. Since load_dotenv() was called AFTER those imports, SUPABASE_URL was an empty string in those modules, so httpx calls hit 'https:///rest/v1/...' which threw '[Errno -2] Name or service not known'. Fix: moved load_dotenv to the very top of server.py (lines 1-8) before any route imports. Verified by observing SUPABASE_URL is populated at import time and /api/organizations/me now returns 200 with real data. The secondary organization_settings join issue is also non-reproducible now (endpoint returns clean payload).
